_role: The machine-readable record of what the autonomy loop may put in public without asking. Read by research/autonomy/publish_bar.py::authority_permits. It is NOT the grant — trimcrae is. This file only records his grant so a script can check it.
_read_this_when: You are about to post anything, or you are about to edit this file. Editing it is a DECLARED change (architecture §10.4): it goes in amendments.jsonl, and it may not be made by the cycle that this file just blocked.
_this_file_disagreeing_with_claude_md_is: CLAUDE.md §3 and AGENTS.md were amended in the same commit that first set standing_grant to true. If a future reader finds this file permitting what those forbid, THIS file is wrong and the post does not happen.

journal._constant: Not a parameter. No bar reaches it, no amendment may set it true. A journal submission costs money, is slow to undo, and picks an identifier someone may cite. It escalates to trimcrae immediately (D4) with the venue shortlist and its evidence.

zenodo_archive_publication._why_a_gate_at_all_when_he_widened_the_g: ⚠ SUPERSEDED, RETAINED (rule 1.2) — the gate this explains no longer exists; see `_why_the_gate_went`. Publishing is irreversible — a published version's files cannot be edited, only superseded — so the cost of a wrong publish is a permanent record he has to supersede in public, under his own ORCID. The grant removes the need for HIM to operate the tooling; it does not remove him from the decision.
preconditions: The authority record names the act (this block).

⛔ The draft's uploaded_manifest_digest EQUALS the archive manifest's archive_content_digest at the commit being posted, re-read at publish time and never inherited from a status line. Publishing a stale draft freezes an archive already behind the paper — the exact defect the whole 2026-08-29/30 correction removed, and it has gone stale twice.
The deposition is a DRAFT of the record the paper cites, not a new record.

⚠ AN `--approved-by` STRING IS STILL REQUIRED AND STILL RECORDED, but it no longer gates: trimcrae retired the per-publication approval on 2026-08-30. It names who authorised the act so the `exercised` list below can be audited.

research_correspondence.granted_by: trimcrae, 2026-09-06, current Codex task, verbatim: "Do it" in direct response to the proposed standing autonomous research correspondence arrangement.
research_correspondence.scope: Routine correspondence for the EMC computation-only research program, tied to a specific worthwhile research dependency.
authorized_acts: Select relevant authors and data custodians and verify their professional contact details.
Send tailored requests for existing research data and methodological clarification.
Handle factual replies, reasonable followups, acknowledgements, referrals, and closure without per-message approval.
Receive and assess permitted non-identifiable research materials while preserving provenance and applicable conditions.
research_correspondence.identity: Identify as an AI research assistant acting with the project owner's authorization, through a dedicated verified research mailbox; no impersonation or invented affiliation.
excluded_acts: Accepting confidentiality, restricted-data or controlled-access obligations.
Requesting identifiable patient information or disclosing private user/project information beyond the approved correspondence context.
Promising authorship, collaboration, publication, institutional approval, ethics attestations, or the user's time.
Journal/preprint submission or other public release under this correspondence grant.
research_correspondence.exception_handling: Ordinarily decline conditions outside scope and pursue alternatives. Escalate only a worthwhile exceptional commitment requiring the user's decision; do not assign routine correspondence to the user.
research_correspondence.notification_intent: No routine notifications; notify only if the overall mission is completely blocked or a finished independently verified preprint is ready.
research_correspondence.transport_requirement: Actual verified sender account and tested send/receive capability. Authorization alone does not establish a connected mailbox or a running worker.
research_correspondence.revocation: A later user instruction can narrow or revoke this grant. Re-read current authority before every outgoing action.
